Random correctness: 60 points for 20 random cases.
Edge correctness: 20 points for 8 boundary cases.
Runtime quality: 10 points for correct cases with normal exit, no stderr and CPU time ≤250ms.
Simplicity: 10 points, split between effective lines and effective size.

Compared with the reference: no deduction up to 1.6 times the lines (minimum 12) or 1.8 times the size (minimum 220 B). Above that, points decrease linearly to zero at twice the threshold. Comments and whitespace do not count toward size. Line count is the larger of effective lines and statement count to prevent one-line compression. Simplicity is multiplied by the pass rate.

Total score is the sum of each problem's personal best: 90×100=9000.

Integers compare exactly; floats allow absolute error ≤0.0001; text is case sensitive. Each case has 3 seconds / 256 MiB. Compilation failure scores zero.

int 保存整数。int value = 0 同时声明并初始化；后续 value: int stores integers. int value = 0 declares and initializes; value = 8 assigns later. = assigns, while == compares. A declaration's scope begins at the declaration and ends with its block. Do not define the same name twice in one scope.

Backslash-n means newline, backslash-t means tab and a doubled backslash means a literal backslash. Print no unrequested input prompts.

- 可以表示减法，也可以表示一元取负。左右操作数的顺序会影响减法结果；负数不需要: - means binary subtraction or unary negation. Operand order matters. A negative integer prints its own minus sign. Use parentheses to make the intended evaluation order explicit.

两个整数相除得到整数，不能保留小数；非负整数除法的余数用 % 求得。除数为0时不: Dividing integers produces an integer and discards fractions. % gives an integer remainder. Neither / nor % may use a zero divisor. Make an operand floating point for fractional averages. C integer division truncates toward zero; a remainder follows the dividend's sign.
double 保存浮点数。3.0 与 3 的类型不同，先进行浮点除法才会得到小数: double stores floating-point values. 3.0 differs in type from 3. Floating division must happen before truncation; assigning a truncated quotient to double cannot restore it. printf %.6f prints six decimal places. scanf uses %lf for double and %f for float.
(类型)表达式显式转换类型。例如 (double)count 在运算前转为浮点数: (type)expression converts explicitly, such as (double)count before division. Conversion to integer discards fractions; a narrower type may not fit. ==、!=、<、<=、>、>= 产生0或1。边界是否包含等号必须与题目一致。不能: ==, !=, <, <=, > and >= yield 0 or 1. Include equality only when the requirement does. Do not write 0<x<10: C compares the intermediate 0 or 1 to 10. Write x>0 && x<10.
条件 ? 值A : 值B 根据真假只计算其中一项。它适合简单取值，复杂逻辑用 i: condition ? valueA : valueB evaluates only the chosen alternative. Use it for simple values; use if/else for complex logic. Nested conditional expressions can be hard to read. Do not sacrifice clarity to save a line.
&& 表示同时成立，|| 表示至少一个成立，! 取反。&& 左侧为假时不计算右侧: && means both; || means at least one; ! negates. A false left side of && skips the right, and a true left side of || skips it. Check bounds or pointer validity on the left before accessing data on the right.
char 可保存单个字符，'a' 与 \"a\" 不同：前者是字符常量，后者是带: char stores a character. 'a' is a character constant, while "a" is a null-terminated string. Compare digit characters with '0' through '9', not numeric 0 through 9. Character arithmetic here assumes the stated ASCII input.
ctype.h 提供字符分类和大小写转换，例如 isdigit、tolower、: ctype.h provides isdigit, tolower, toupper and related functions. Arguments must be EOF or representable as unsigned char. Cast char when needed. A true classification result is nonzero, not necessarily 1.
switch 按整数或字符值匹配 case 标签。case 结尾通常需要 bre: switch selects integer or character case labels. Usually end each case with break to avoid fall-through. default handles other values. switch cannot compare string contents; use strcmp.
for 循环、循环变量与重复次数: for loops, variables and iteration counts
for(初始化;继续条件;每轮更新) 在每次执行循环体前检查条件。i++ 先取得: for(initialization;condition;update) checks before each iteration. i++ yields the old value; ++i yields the new one. Used alone as the update, both increment once. Do not modify a variable multiple times in an unsequenced expression. Check loop boundaries carefully.
while(条件) 在每轮开始前检查，第一次条件不成立时循环体一次也不执行。循环: while checks before each iteration and may execute zero times. Update the state to avoid infinite loops. It suits repeated reading, digit extraction and remainder-based algorithms.
do / while 至少执行一次: do / while executes at least once
do { ... } while(条件); 先执行再检查，因此至少执行一次。最后: do { ... } while(condition); checks after the body, so it executes at least once. Keep the final semicolon. It is useful when input zero must still be processed; a regular while needs a separate zero case.
+=、-=、*=、/=、%= 将运算结果赋回左侧，例如 sum += value: +=, -=, *=, /= and %= calculate and assign back, as in sum += value. Start sums at 0 and products at 1. Give each state variable a clear meaning and preserve old values before overwriting them.
long long 至少64位，适合阶乘、较大乘积和累积和。scanf/prin: long long has at least 64 bits and suits factorials, large products and sums. scanf/printf use %lld. Widen before intermediate arithmetic. It is still bounded and is not an arbitrary-precision integer.
break 退出当前最内层循环或 switch；continue 跳过当前循环剩: break exits the innermost loop or switch. continue skips the rest of the current iteration. A first-match search can stop once found. break in a nested loop does not exit the outer loop.
类型 a[N] 为N个连续元素分配空间，下标为0～N-1。a[N] 已越界。{0: T a[N] allocates N elements with indices 0 through N-1. a[N] is out of bounds. {0} initializes every element to zero. Uninitialized local arrays contain indeterminate values. Allocate for the maximum size but traverse only the actual length.
& 按位与、| 按位或、^ 按位异或，<< 和 >> 是移位；它们不同于 &&、: & is bitwise AND, | OR, ^ XOR, and << / >> shift. They differ from && and ||. For nonnegative x, x&1 tests the lowest bit. Keep shift counts within the type width and take care with signed shifts and overflow.
C 字符串以 '\\0' 结束，缓冲区至少比有效字符多一个位置。scanf 的: C strings end with a null character, so reserve one extra byte. scanf %Ns reads at most N non-whitespace characters. strlen from string.h excludes the terminator and returns size_t.
fgets 读整行与残留换行: fgets, whole lines and leftover newlines
fgets(buffer,capacity,stdin) 最多读取 capaci: fgets(buffer,capacity,stdin) reads at most capacity-1 characters and terminates them. It may include the newline. %s cannot preserve spaces or empty lines. When mixing scanf and fgets, explicitly handle the previous leftover newline.
二维数组 a[R][C] 有行、列两个下标，合法范围分别是0～R-1、0～C-1: a[R][C] has row indices 0..R-1 and column indices 0..C-1. Storage is row-major. Keep i and j responsibilities separate, and reset an inner loop's starting index on every outer iteration.
T *p 保存T对象地址，&x 取地址，*p 读写所指对象。函数参数默认按值传递: T *p stores the address of a T. &x takes an address; *p reads or writes the object. Parameters are passed by value, but passing an address lets a function modify the caller's object. p+i moves in elements within a valid array range. Never dereference NULL.
函数由返回类型、名称、参数列表和函数体组成；调用前需要可见的声明或定义。void: A function has a return type, name, parameters and body. Its declaration or definition must be visible before calling. void means no return value. Parameters copy argument values, but pointers can access caller objects. Never return the address of an expired local object.
递归是在函数中再次调用自身。必须先写可直接返回的基本情况，并让每次调用都更接近它: Recursion calls the same function again. Define a base case and make every call approach it. Each unfinished call uses stack space for local state; deep recursion may exhaust the stack. Factorial and Euclid's algorithm can also be iterative.
strcmp 比较两个以零结尾的字符串，strncmp 最多比较指定字符数；返回: strcmp compares null-terminated strings; strncmp compares at most a given count. Negative, zero and positive indicate ordering; zero means equal. == on pointers or array names compares addresses, not contents. The specified range must still be safe to read.
struct 把相关字段组成一条记录；object.field 访问字段，poi: struct groups related fields. object.field accesses a field; pointer->field accesses through a pointer. typedef gives a type alias. Structure assignment copies field values, not dynamically allocated objects pointed to by pointer fields.
malloc / free、sizeof 与链表: malloc / free, sizeof and linked lists
malloc 分配指定字节，失败返回 NULL；calloc 还会清零。size: malloc allocates bytes and returns NULL on failure; calloc also zeroes them. sizeof(*p) gives the pointed-to object's size. Check allocation, and free every allocated object when done. Save next before freeing a list node; never access a freed node.
sizeof 返回对象或类型占用的字节数，结果类型为 size_t。数组的 si: sizeof returns an object's or type's byte size as size_t. Applied to an array it gives the whole array size. An array parameter has become a pointer, so sizeof(parameter) cannot recover the original length.
全局对象和 static 对象有静态存储期，默认零初始化并存活到程序结束。普通局: Global and static objects are zero-initialized and live until program exit. Ordinary local objects expire at scope exit. A static local retains its value between calls; decide when to reset it for multiple input sets.
qsort 来自 stdlib.h，参数包含数组、元素个数、单个元素字节数与比较: qsort in stdlib.h receives an array, count, element size and comparator. The comparator takes const void* and reads the correct type, returning negative, zero or positive without changing the objects. Avoid subtracting arbitrary integers if subtraction could overflow.
memcpy 按字节复制，要求源、目标区域不重叠；有重叠时使用 memmove。: memcpy copies bytes between nonoverlapping regions; use memmove for overlap. memset repeats a byte, not an arbitrary int value. String copying must reserve room for the terminator.

本关首次出现的 C 语法与用法: C syntax and usage introduced in this level
预处理：#include <stdio.h> 提供输入输出声明，stdlib.h: Preprocessing: #include <stdio.h> declares I/O functions; stdlib.h provides allocation and sorting; string.h provides string operations; limits.h defines integer limits. Include headers for the features you use.
类型与初始化：int 为整数，long long 容量更大；局部变量先初始化再读: Types and initialization: int stores integers; long long is wider. Initialize local variables before reading them. = after a declaration gives an initial value; {0} zero-initializes an array.
入口与函数：int main(void) 表示无参数入口；return 0 正常: Entry and functions: int main(void) is an entry point without parameters; return 0 exits normally. A function has a return type, name, parameter list and body, and needs a visible declaration before use.
输入与输出：scanf 按格式读取，&x 提供变量地址；%d、%lld、%llu: I/O: scanf reads by format and uses &x for an address. %d, %lld, %llu and %s correspond to int, long long, unsigned long long and strings. Pass a character array name directly; %Ns bounds input length. printf does not use &. Match every format to its type.
循环：for(初值;条件;更新) 和 while(条件) 都在条件成立时重复；i: Loops: for(initial;condition;update) and while(condition) repeat while true. Postfix i++/i-- use the old value; prefix ++i/--i use the new. while(q--) tests the old q and then decrements. break exits a loop; continue starts its next iteration.
表达式：+ - * / % 进行算术运算，整数除法截断。+= -= *= /=: Expressions: + - * / % perform arithmetic; integer division truncates. += -= *= /= %= assign the result back. Check overflow and widen before multiplication with (long long)x*y. == != < <= > >= compare; = assigns.
选择与逻辑：if/else 决定分支；条件?真值:假值 是条件运算符。&& 和: Selection and logic: if/else selects a branch; condition?trueValue:falseValue selects an expression. && and || short circuit; ! negates. Test bounds before reading an array. Logical operators differ from bitwise & and |.
数组与地址：下标从0开始，大小N的合法下标为0到N-1。a[i] 是元素，&a[: Arrays and addresses: N elements have indices 0 through N-1. a[i] is a value; &a[i] and a+i are its address. Array parameters normally become pointers and do not carry a length; pass it separately.
字符与字符串：'a' 是字符，\"abc\" 是包含结尾 '\u0000' 的字: Characters and strings: a character literal differs from a null-terminated string. Character subtraction can find relative codes. Backslash-n means newline, backslash-t means tab, and a doubled backslash represents one backslash. Reserve space for the string terminator.
字符串库：strlen 返回不含结束符的长度，返回类型 size_t；strcm: String library: strlen returns length without the terminator as size_t. strcmp/strncmp return negative, zero or positive; zero means equal contents. == compares addresses, not string contents. strncmp compares at most the specified bytes.
存储期：静态局部或全局对象生存到程序结束并默认零初始化；普通局部对象随作用域结束: Lifetime: static local and global objects are zero-initialized and live until exit. Ordinary local objects expire with their scope; uninitialized values are indeterminate. Never retain a local object address beyond its lifetime.
记录类型：struct 合并字段，typedef 提供别名。对象.field 访: Records: struct groups fields and typedef provides an alias. object.field accesses a field; pointer->field accesses through a pointer. const prevents modification through that name.
指针：T *p 保存T对象的地址；*p 解引用，&x 取地址。NULL 不能解引: Pointers: T *p holds a T address; *p dereferences and &x takes an address. Never dereference NULL. Pointer arithmetic must remain within the valid array range. void* is a generic object pointer; convert back to the correct type before reading.
排序与大小：sizeof 返回对象或类型的字节数。qsort(base,coun: Sorting and size: sizeof gives an object or type size in bytes. qsort(base,count,sizeof(element),compare) uses a comparator taking two const void* and returning negative, zero or positive. Do not modify the compared objects.
位运算：& 按位与，| 按位或，^ 按位异或；<< 和 >> 移位。1<<i 构: Bits: & is AND, | OR, ^ XOR, and << / >> shift. 1<<i constructs a bit; x&1 tests the lowest bit; i&-i isolates the low bit. Keep shift counts within type width and follow signed-integer rules.
内存复制：memcpy(dest,src,size) 按字节复制，不保证字符串结: Memory copying: memcpy(dest,src,size) copies nonoverlapping bytes and does not automatically add a string terminator. memmove allows overlap. sizeof(an actual array) gives its total size, but sizeof(a pointer) does not.

Backslash-n means newline, backslash-t means tab, and a doubled backslash represents one backslash. Reserve space for the string terminator.
